source_priority: User observed per-entry 12 ingots replaces the prior per-node allowance; stored balance conversion cost retains pinned PRTS evidence.

bank_cost_evidence.excerpt: 余额提取 功能解锁后，无论是否投资受限，都可以消耗一定的系统余额提取1源石锭。 通常情况下，每次提取消耗和当前节点取款次数相同的余额提取1源石锭（最高7源石锭/次），单个节点最多提取12次。
bank_cost_evidence.interpretation: withdrawal n accumulated within the current node consumes min(n,7) bank balance and grants exactly 1 ingot; re-entry resets the user-observed allowance but not the node cost counter. The first 12 withdrawals at one node spend 63 balance; later full 12-withdrawal entries at that node spend 84.

default_balance_evidence: ASSUMED_ACCOUNT_START_BALANCE; cumulative investment of 500 does not itself prove 999 available balance
unknowns: User per-entry allowance replaces the old source per-node cap only. The old source explicitly scopes conversion cost to current-node withdrawal count, which is preserved across re-entry.
